summary: Reitar Logtech Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting that two senior promissory notes issued in December 2025, totaling US$2.2 million principal, were fully converted by holders Crom and FirstFire into Class A ordinary shares between July and August 2026. No cash was paid; the notes, including original issue discount and interest, were extinguished. This is a routine debt-to-equity conversion, not a special-situation event. The company views it as reducing indebtedness without cash outlay, removing a capital-structure overhang. No pricing, premium, or board recommendation details were disclosed. No further action or arbitrage angle applies.
